context: Saito explains brain-rest advice to a patient.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: medical advice; clinical vocabulary (脳/身体/リスク/得る) seeded in natural home.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 最近、頭がぼんやりするんです。
lines.style: tired office woman voice, soft warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 脳も、休みを必要としています。
lines.style: calm doctor voice, soft warm reassuring measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 身体は元気なのに、不思議ですね。
lines.en: My body's fine, so it's strange.
lines.style: puzzled office woman voice, soft warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 身体と脳の疲れは、別ものです。
lines.en: Bodily and mental fatigue are different.
lines.style: clear doctor voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 放っておくと、リスクはありますか?
lines.en: If I leave it, is there a risk?
lines.style: concerned office woman voice, soft warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 休めば、リスクは下げられると知れます。
lines.en: You'll find that resting lowers the risk.
lines.style: reassuring doctor voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 睡眠から、力を得るんですね。
lines.en: So I gain strength from sleep.
lines.style: understanding office woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ええ、脳を労わってあげて下さい。
lines.en: Yes, please be kind to your brain.
lines.style: gentle doctor voice, soft warm caring closing clarity throughout
